roster: exact development_object_ids in deform360_action_kernel_v3.json; no replacements or expansion
split: use only exact source episodes in the hash-verified historical v2 development artifact; evaluate their highest ID and fit the rest; exclude every original target and all subsequently added carriers
point_method: unchanged v3 action ridge/kernel generalized-Bayes recipe, newly fit on the declared source split; shared by every arm
source_preprocessing: unchanged v2/v3 32-frame horizon, stride 8, pooled tactile normalization, common-endpoint robot alignment
threshold_source: training-episode future query values only; signed total_load, absolute other queries
marginals: identical centered empirical source residual quantiles in query space; rank coupling changes only dependence
structured_dependence: project unchanged v3 low-rank-plus-diagonal residual covariance into the five queries; convert to correlation
query_gaussian: direct five-query empirical residual correlation, not projected field covariance
empirical_copula: source residual row ranks with identical query marginals
scramble: fixed query permutation [2,4,1,0,3] and signs [1,-1,1,-1,1]; PSD and unit diagonal preserved
direct_logistic_features: same source-fitted tactile state/trends/summary, known action features, and common query mean; no future tactile
primary_metric: physical-object-balanced mean Brier score across all five joint events
secondary_metrics: matched-activity direct-logistic and random decision loss
multiple_comparisons: report ordinary 95% and Bonferroni-adjusted percentile physical-object bootstrap intervals; no window-independence inference
superiority_gate: at least 10 evaluable objects and all six adjusted Brier difference upper bounds below zero
decision_gate: separate: structured loss below always-fallback and always-execute, and mean execute fraction at least 0.2; not a robot deployment guarantee
runtime: CPU only; one attempt, failures retained; no automatic empirical retry
interpretation: Passive normalized tactile forecasting, not force-calibrated 3-D twin accuracy or counterfactual control. A positive result supports query dependence on this retrospective split, not a new inference algorithm. A negative result is frozen without retuning. Outcome artifacts remain private.
